title: Madeira Tropical Fruits: What to Try and When It Is in Season
description: Madeira tropical fruits explained: custard apple, passion fruit, fruta delícia and bananas, with the best season for each and where to buy them in Funchal.
heroAlt: A stall of tropical fruit at the Mercado dos Lavradores in Funchal, Madeira

images.prompt: Wide photograph of a colourful tropical fruit stall at the Mercado dos Lavradores in Funchal, Madeira, with custard apples, passion fruit, bananas and fruta delicia piled in baskets under warm morning light.
images.alt: Tropical fruit stall at the Funchal market in Madeira

images.prompt: Close-up photograph of a ripe fruta delicia (Monstera fruit) cut open on a wooden market table in Funchal, Madeira, next to halved passion fruit, soft natural daylight.
images.alt: A ripe fruta delícia and passion fruit on a market table
